title: Realtime changes
description: Subscribe to the organization change stream for a Mongo collection or a Postgres table with an anon key and watch changes live.
workspaceLoadingDescription: Loading the accessible workspaces of the active organization.
workspaceErrorDescription: Retry to load the available workspaces.
workspaceDescription: Select a workspace to use realtime.
workspaceDenied: This organization has no workspaces yet. Ask an organization or workspace owner or administrator to create the first one.
formDescription: Choose the source, enter the target and the anon key, then press Subscribe.
validationMongo: Database, collection and anon key are required
validationPostgres: Database, table and anon key are required
streamError: Stream error: check the key, the target and that the workspace server supports change streams
firstRunDescription: Changes will appear here as soon as you subscribe.
firstRunStep1: Choose whether the source is a Mongo collection or a Postgres table.
firstRunStep2: Enter the database, the target and the anon key.
firstRunStep3: Press Subscribe and write to the target to see changes.
listeningMongo: Listening… write to the collection to see changes.
listeningPostgres: Listening… write to the table to see changes.
jsonSelectHint: Select a node to copy its path or its value.
noAccessDescription: The server did not accept the anon key for this target. Check the key and try again.
notFoundDescription: The server did not find the target. Check the database and the target, or browse the source data.
errorTitle: The change stream could not be kept open
errorDescription: The server returned an error while opening the stream. Retry to open a new subscription.
droppedDescription: The connection to the stream was lost and is reconnecting. Earlier lines were received before the disconnection; retry to open a new subscription.
announceChanges: {count, plural, one {# new change} other {# new changes}}
